text: When Laura was called to the telephone. <break time="0.8s" /> She met her brother Laurie in the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> And, giving him a small quick squeeze. <break time="0.8s" /> She cried, Oh, I do love parties. <break time="0.8s" /> On the telephone she invited Kitty Maitland to lunch. <break time="0.8s" /> While her mothers voice floated down the stairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Telling Laura that Kitty must wear. <break time="0.8s" /> The sweet hat she had worn last Sunday. <break time="0.8s" /> The house was alive. <break time="0.8s" /> With quick steps and running voices. <break time="0.8s" /> And little spots of sunlight played. <break time="0.8s" /> On the inkpot and the silver photograph frame. <break time="0.8s" /> As if they too were enjoying the day. <break time="0.8s" /> A man from the florist arrived. <break time="0.8s" /> With a wide tray full of pink canna lilies. <break time="0.8s" /> So many that Laura cried out in surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> And her mother confessed. <break time="0.8s" /> That she had ordered them herself. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw them in a shop window yesterday. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Missus Sheridan. <break time="0.8s" /> And I suddenly thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That for once in my life. <break time="0.8s" /> I would have enough canna lilies. <break time="0.8s" /> In the drawing room Jose tested the piano. <break time="0.8s" /> By singing a sad song about a weary life. <break time="0.8s" /> And then she smiled. <break time="0.8s" /> A brilliant, unsympathetic smile. <break time="0.8s" /> Sure that she was in good voice. <break time="0.8s" /> In the kitchen. <break time="0.8s" /> There were fifteen different kinds of sandwiches. <break time="0.8s" /> And the cook. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had made every one of them. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiled with pride. <break time="0.8s" /> When Jose praised her work. <break time="0.8s" /> When the man from Godbers brought cream puffs. <break time="0.8s" /> The cook let each girl have one. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon they were licking. <break time="0.8s" /> Whipped cream from their fingers.
